name: io.github.henryjrobinson/eve-mentor-mcp
description: An AI mentor for new and returning EVE Online players: explains your real losses from zKillboard, works out what to train to fly any ship or fit, checks fits for classic mistakes, shows what pilots actually fly, finds your stranded assets, and sorts you into a playstyle — all from live EVE data.
